name: labs/hslarson__speck-lab-goniometer
title: Thorlabs compact spectrometer (pyCCT SpectrometerWrapper)
intro: Thorlabs compact spectrometer (pyCCT SpectrometerWrapper), adapted from hslarson/speck-lab-goniometer. It reads `device_id`; sets `manual_exposure`, `hardware_average`, `input_hw_trigger_enabled`, `input_hw_trigger_average_no_wait` and 3 more; runs `acquire_spectrum`. `acquire_spectrum`: acquire an optical or mass spectrum over a declared wavelength or mass range and return the axis and intensity arrays, or an artifact reference for large spectra. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
